sources.prompt:
Japanese anime-style chibi mobile-game environment art, like the tile set of a cosy slice-of-life anime puzzle game. Drawn by hand by a professional 2D anime game background artist: flat cel colours with one crisp hard-edged shadow tone, thick dark-brown outline (#4A2A1A) with slight natural line-weight variation (thicker on outer silhouettes, thinner on inner details), one small flat white highlight per shiny surface, chunky rounded chibi shapes (buildings, trees, rocks and props squashed and rounded like cute toys), limited warm Japanese palette, light from the top-left. Few, deliberate details, every shape clearly readable at 64 pixels. Avoid the typical AI-art look: no airbrushed or soft gradient shading, no plastic or 3D-render sheen, no photographic texture, no texture noise, no random extra sparkles or particles, no melted or merged details, no blurry edges. No characters or people unless asked, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Outline weight matches a cartoon salmon-nigiri game icon.

Setting: the Okinawa Beach Shack region of the map, a tropical Okinawa beach: turquoise sea, palm trees, hibiscus, red-tiled roofs with shisa lion statues and a straw beach shack. Region colours: banner #2EC4B6 to #138A8A, land #F0DFAE.

Tile sheet: 2x2 grid of 4 equal 512x512 cells, one item per cell, no borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels, no numbers. Straight top-down view, flat, no perspective. Every item at the same scale with the same outline weight. Ground tiles fill their cell edge to edge, opaque, with no outline or border round the cell; the left edge matches the right edge and the top edge matches the bottom edge so each repeats seamlessly.

Land:
f1 (top-left) land_a: warm golden sand in #F0DFAE.
f2 (top-right) land_b: the same ground about 12% lighter, details in other places, so it alternates with land_a.
f3 (bottom-left) land_c: land_a with a small seashell and a starfish.
f4 (bottom-right) land_d: land_b with a small seashell and a starfish.
Use case: stylized-concept. Output a square 1024x1024 opaque PNG sheet with four exact equal logical quadrants, no visible grid or gutters. Straight top-down flat 2D ground. Uniform warm golden sand #F0DFAE for left-column cells, about 12% lighter pale golden sand #F8EBCB for right-column cells. A few very sparse small low-contrast curved sand-ripple strokes in different positions. Each lower cell has exactly ONE small seashell and ONE small five-armed starfish, placed differently, with crisp dark-brown outlines and simple flat cel fills. All details stay at least 12% away from each quadrant's edges. Border regions must be plain solid sand, edge to edge, for seamless repetition. No gradients, realistic grain, mottling, noisy textures, vignette, outlined tile borders, plants, water or scenic props.

Deco tiles:

Use case: stylized-concept. Output square 1024x1024 transparent PNG atlas with four exact equal logical quadrants, no visible grid. Every COMPLETE prop must fit inside the INNER 70% of its quadrant, with at least 15% transparent margin on every side, no clipping or crossing central boundaries. Top-left: green limestone hill with a clearly visible sea cave opening and a tiny turquoise water inlet at its foot. Top-right: EXACTLY TWO palms with a small RED hibiscus bush at their base. Bottom-left: one small Okinawan house with red tiled roof and a clearly readable tiny SHISA guardian lion statue perched on top. Bottom-right: one small straw-roofed beach shack with a plain surfboard leaning against it. View from above at 45 degrees, chunky rounded shapes, flat cel fills, one hard shadow tone and thick dark-brown outlines #4A2A1A. Transparent space outside each standalone object, no shared ground or backdrop, no words, labels or symbols. No gradients, photo textures or cast shadow haze. Preserve full outer silhouettes with a clear transparent gap between all four props.
